name: Bump-based Marching Cubes
definition: A Marching Cubes implementation that leverages the Bump library to support both structured (Cartesian) and unstructured (quad/hex) meshes, unlike the native implementation which only supports structured grids.
summary: Bump-based Marching Cubes is a policy-based isosurface extraction method that supports unstructured meshes, unlike the native implementation which only handles structured grids.
